description: This file defines the ModuleConfigurationService interface, which extends a generic service interface and declares methods for retrieving integration modules and modules by code within the system configuration context.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage and retrieve system integration modules.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of integration modules based on the provided module identifier.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IntegrationModule based on its unique code.
